en.name: The Devoted Lambs of the Eucharist
en.summary: A lamb and a sheep are recorded in the life of Saint Francis as bowing before the Blessed Sacrament.
en.body: Saint Bonaventure's life of Saint Francis of Assisi records a lamb that accompanied a noblewoman to Mass in Rome, and separately a sheep at the Porziuncola said to have bowed at the moment of the elevation of the Host.
